detail.longDescription: Selected model is at capacity I'm using ChatGPT, and every time I try to send a message I get this error: Selected model is at capacity. Please try a different model. It appears right after I hit send or after it think for a second, so I never get a reply. I've already ruled out the obvious causes: my quota has not run out, and my network connection is working normally. I've tried refreshing the page and switching models, but the same error comes back. Could someone explain what triggers this and how to fix it? Is it a temporary capacity problem on ChatGPTcome's side, or something in my own settings? If it's a model availability or rate limit issue, how long does it usually last, and is there any workaround? Any help would be appreciated. Thanks!
